mapper.insert: insert into clazz(name, room, begin_date, end_date, master_id, subject, create_time, update_time) values(#{name}, #{room}, #{beginDate}, #{endDate}, #{masterId}, #{subject}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select:
SELECT clazz.id, clazz.name, clazz.room, clazz.begin_date, clazz.end_date, clazz.master_id, clazz.create_time, clazz.update_time, emp.name as master_name, CASE WHEN NOW() > clazz.end_date THEN '已结课' WHEN NOW() < clazz.begin_date THEN '未开班' ELSE '在读中' END as status FROM clazz LEFT JOIN emp ON clazz.master_id = emp.id
clazz.name like concat('%',#{name},'%')
and clazz.begin_date between #{begin} and #{end}
ORDER BY clazz.update_time DESC

SELECT clazz.id, clazz.name, clazz.room, clazz.begin_date, clazz.end_date, clazz.master_id, clazz.subject, clazz.create_time, clazz.update_time, emp.name as master_name, CASE WHEN NOW() > clazz.end_date THEN '已结课' WHEN NOW() < clazz.begin_date THEN '未开班' ELSE '在读中' END as status FROM clazz LEFT JOIN emp ON clazz.master_id = emp.id WHERE clazz.id = #{id}
